Dialogue_Text: You came back, <CHARNAME>. Orin was waiting downstairs.
Selene, you were right. I was too quick to blame him.
I promised Selene that I would help her. Orin owes her an apology.
Orin, were you injured? I was worried about you.
You saved her, traveler. I owe you my life.
Then keep your promise, Orin. Meet us at dawn.
